benefits.title: Why EVAA?
benefits.desc1: EVAA is the leading DeFi superlayer on Telegram. As a liquidity protocol, EVAA simplifies earning yields, making payments, and taking out loans. It delivers an experience with innovative financial services and the best decentralized borrowing.
benefits.desc2: EVAA supporting TON, jettons, and wrapped assets from other chains, maximizes the utility of TON blockchain. This enables seamless interaction with a variety of digital assets, offering users exquisite experience.
benefits.desc3: EVAA enhances user experience by supporting a Telegram mini app, offering a seamless and customized interface within Telegram itself. This integration provides convenience and a native feel directly in Telegram.
benefits.desc4: EVAA supports TON Space, Telegram's non- custodial wallet, allowing you to manage your assets directly within Telegram. No need to switch apps—EVAA brings streamlined blockchain lending right to where you are.
benefits.desc5: The EVAA Card bridges the gap between yield and payment, allowing you to pay and earn at once. Earn yield on your balance while spending, accessing liquidity for daily use without selling crypto. Spend against your deposit and pay directly from EVAA, skipping the need to off-ramp to fiat.

faq.title: Have <0/> questions?
faq.desc1: EVAA lending protocol is a decentralized finance platform that leverages TON blockchain technology to enable secure and efficient borrowing and lending of digital assets. Users can participate as lenders to earn interest or as borrowers to access loans by collateralizing their cryptocurrency holdings
faq.subtitle2: How does the EVAA lending protocol ensure security?
faq.desc2: EVAA lending protocol ensures security through smart contracts on the blockchain, which enforce the terms of each loan automatically. Additionally, it employs rigorous risk assessment protocols and collateral requirements to protect the interests of lenders and borrowers. We are constantly increasing our security in collaboration with professional smart contract auditors.
faq.subtitle3: What cryptocurrencies can be used on the EVAA lending platform?
faq.desc3: The EVAA lending platform supports a variety of cryptocurrencies for lending and borrowing. These include GRAM, stablecoins, popular liquid tokens, GRAM derivatives with liquid staking, and LP tokens. The specific assets available can vary based on market demand and the platform`s governance decisions.
faq.subtitle4: How are interest rates determined on the EVAA lending protocol?
faq.desc4: Interest rates are determined by supply and demand dynamics within the platform. Rates fluctuate based on the available liquidity of a particular asset and the current demand for loans, ensuring a fair and market-driven interest model.
faq.subtitle5: What happens in case of a collateral shortfall or loan skyrocketing?
faq.desc5: Once your Health Factor hits 0%, your loan becomes vulnerable to liquidation. If your account is at risk of liquidation, our Third Party Liquidators may repay up to 1/3 of your loans by selling the corresponding amount of your collateral (a part of your deposit). In doing so, these liquidators will earn an extra 15% on the liquidated sum as a bounty to fortify our protocol.
faq.subtitle6: When and how are funds accrued for Supply APY?
faq.desc6: The supply amount for lenders increases with each new block in the chain depending on the APY in the protocol itself.
faq.subtitle7: What kind of price feeds does EVAA use?
faq.desc7: EVAA uses Pyth price feeds fully on-chain. We are the first protocol in the TON ecosystem to support Pyth prices, setting a higher security standard for oracle-based pricing from day one.
faq.subtitle8: What are the current fees in EVAA?
faq.desc8: EVAA doesn’t charge any fees for supplying tokens — you only pay the network gas fee for the deposit and start earning your yield. EVAA also doesn’t charge a loan origination fee for borrowing. The only cost is interest (APY), which accrues over time and increases your outstanding loan amount according to the current rate.
faq.subtitle9: Can I supply and borrow the same token?
faq.desc9: No, you cannot be both a supplier and borrower of the same token.
faq.subtitle10: Can I supply GRAM and USDT, and borrow USDT?
faq.desc10: In this case, you are a supplier of USDT and want to borrow it as well. You cannot supply and borrow the same token.
faq.subtitle11: What utility do all EVAA NFTs have?
faq.desc11: EVAA Friend NFT grants access to a private chat with the EVAA core team and gives holders a 5% boost to the base referral rewards (bringing the total referral reward to 15%). Boost NFT allows holders to increase their base $EVAA mining rate by 5%.
faq.subtitle12: Where can I view EVAA’s security audit report?
faq.desc12: We have <0>successfully completed</0> two independent audits by <1>Quantstamp</1> and <2>Trail of Bits</2>—recognized leaders in smart contract auditing across the TON ecosystem and beyond. Full reports: <3>Quantstamp</3> and <4>Trail of Bits</4>.
